ctx.x: So that band -- so when we were shipped out, the band, authorized band, wasn't under the jurisdiction of the regiment. So when the band was shipped out the Colonel took
all the musicians who were attached to the band with him, down to Breckenridge. Then he gave us the barrack to form another band. So that's how that came about.

Then Breckenridge. So -- well, incidentally, when I -- so, you see, it was unauthorized, so we didn't have the TO. The TO is the Table of Organization which means, you know, you have so many ranks in whatever. So ours wasn't like that. We had a Sergeant who was in charge of the band, then by that time I was a Technician 5th Grade, which is a two-striper, you know, a Corporal.
